sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
"From time to time, rumors spread through Tarkov about a special unit that belongs neither to USEC nor BEAR. According to campfire stories, these special operatives conduct night-time operations to clear restricted facilities and extract valuable TerraGroup data. But among PMC operators, very few believe in the existence of this so-called "Black Division", because under the current circumstances, freely inserting and extracting entire combat groups through the blockade ring is practically impossible." (In game description)

The Black Division is a faction in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
Seasonal change: Black Divison on Ground Zero (Level 21+), Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov and Woods have 70 health on the head, 120 on each arm, and 130 on each leg, bringing their total to 880 health.
- Killing Black Division operatives as a Scav does not carry any penalties towards your Scav karma.
- Black Division operatives have different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 40; Thorax: 170; Stomach: 140; Arms: 110 each; Legs: 110 each; Total: 790 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, they have 3x (2x3 slot) and 2x (1x3 slot) pockets, bringing their total space to 24 slots.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
The Black Division can be found on Icebreaker and Terminal.
Seasonal change: Black Division can rarely appear on Ground Zero (Level 21+), Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov and Woods, while also permanently occupying The Lab.
